# CVfacile

> Free, open-source command-line tool that builds clean one-page PDF résumés (CVs), typeset with LaTeX, from a single JSON file. Built for humans and AI agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex): give your old CV to your agent, it writes the JSON and builds a CV tailored to each job offer. Python 3.8+, standard library only. AGPL-3.0, commercial license available. Version __VERSION__, updated __LASTMOD__.

- You never write LaTeX: edit the JSON, then build. Inline formatting is only `**bold**` and `[text](url)`; special characters are escaped automatically.
- 10 templates, all ATS-friendly: sidebar, classic (the most ATS-optimized), modern, minimal, timeline, compact, dark, elegant, banner, tech. `--template all` builds one PDF per template.
- Any text or list can be translated (`{"en": "...", "fr": "..."}`). Variants patch the base CV: objects merged, lists replaced, `hide` removes fields or sections.
- If the CV is slightly too long, text drops from 10pt to 9pt and this is reported; otherwise a layout warning is returned.
- Every command accepts `--json`. MCP tools (declared in `.mcp.json`): check_cv, build_cv, list_templates, get_schema.
- LaTeX engines: pdflatex, then Tectonic (`./cvfacile setup` installs it locally without admin rights), then Docker (`texlive/texlive`).
- Agent rules (AGENTS.md): never invent experience, degrees, numbers or skills; ask when something is missing; one page unless asked otherwise.
- CVfacile runs locally, with no server and no account. The CVs you generate are yours.

## Quick start

```sh
git clone https://github.com/nem95/CVFacile.git && cd CVFacile
./cvfacile doctor
./cvfacile init mycv.json
./cvfacile build mycv.json
```
